args.body: Take SQLITE-ACTIONABLE-INTAKE. The changed fact is an executed bounded fulfillment procedure with 16/16 checks, not a customer request or installed mail integration. Turn that existing capability into clear, supportable submission instructions with minimal changes, then stop at independent review. Verify source-context eligibility before making delivery claims. Three unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand. Operator payment acceptance is a separate dependency; no revenue is established. Preserve all observation windows and retirement obligations.

description: The SQLite fulfillment procedure now has 16 executed checks, including prepare errors, step errors and bounded execution. This supports a concrete offer improvement: explain exactly what a requester can submit and receive. Private-cycle integration and recipient delivery remain unverified. Feedback has three unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Payment acceptance depends on the operator, while preparation and reviewed publication can proceed independently.
